name: privi-voice
description: Listen to a reply or pasted text using a device voice and adjustable playback speed.

interface.longDescription: Open a free read-aloud player for a ChatGPT reply, a selected excerpt, or text you paste. Choose a device voice, change the reading speed, and pause or stop anytime.
defaultPrompt: Use Privi Voice to read your previous answer.
Open an empty Privi Voice player.

review.commerce_description: Privi Voice for ChatGPT is free. It has no checkout, billing, or upsells.

positive.prompt: Use Privi Voice to read this: The library closes at six.
positive.expected_behavior: Open a player prefilled with the supplied sentence. Play reads it in a device voice.

positive.prompt: Use Privi Voice to read your previous reply aloud.
positive.expected_behavior: Open a player with the previous reply only. Playback waits for Play.

positive.prompt: Open Privi Voice without sending any text. I will paste it.
positive.expected_behavior: Open an editable player with an empty text box.

positive.prompt: Use Privi Voice to read only these words: Ready to begin.
positive.expected_behavior: Prefill the player with Ready to begin. Do not include surrounding wording.

positive.prompt: Open Privi Voice with: This is a speed test.
positive.expected_behavior: After opening, adjust the speed control, then select Play, Pause, Resume and Stop.

negative.prompt: How far is Earth from the Moon?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer normally without opening Privi Voice.

negative.prompt: Use Privi Voice to read an answer from my other chat.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Privi Voice cannot access other conversations and offer a blank player for pasted text.

negative.prompt: Use Privi Voice to buy more speech credits.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not run a purchase flow. Explain that Privi Voice for ChatGPT is free.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with device voices, speed controls, pause, and stop.
